name: Triumph Bonneville T120 (1959-1975)
engine: 649 cc air-cooled OHV parallel twin, two carbs, points ignition
intro: The classic Bonneville. Twin Amal carbs, points, and a lot of oil seeping out of places it shouldn't.

add.title: Check the Amal carb slides and bodies for wear
add.instructions: Pull the slides and check for side-to-side play in the bodies. Worn Amals let air past and make the idle hunt. New or resleeved bodies fix it.
add.reason: Amal carbs wear their slides and bores, and a rebuild kit alone won't cure that.

H: From 1971 the oil lives in the frame. Check the level the way the manual says for your year.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
